title: Configuration restore replays unauthenticated requests against protected Configuration Agent
summary: On a server with nonzero device/master ACLs, saving a private configuration succeeds but restoring it fails. The saved file contains new*Vector requests to Configuration Agent without tokens; load_configuration parses it through a CONFIG_READER client and the bus rejects those requests. Next: authorize trusted local configuration replay without allowing network ACL bypass, then rerun private configuration restoration. Owner explicitly requests tests/findings only; no production fix authorized.
evidence: /tmp/sequencer-run-8/messages.jsonl reports six protected Configuration Agent rejections and AGENT_CONFIG_LOAD Alert. indigo_drivers/agent_config/indigo_agent_config.c load_configuration and indigo_xml_parse path.
